name: buffer out of range reads and writes throw ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE
source: function t(f: () => any): void { try { console.log(f()); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.name + ' ' + e.code + ' ' + e.message); } } function main(): void { const buf: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(8); t(() => buf.readUInt32BE(6)); t(() => buf.readUIntBE(7, 3)); t(() => buf.readBigInt64BE(1)); t(() => buf.readUInt8(-1)); t(() => buf.readUInt8(1.5)); t(() => buf.writeUInt32BE(1, 6)); t(() => buf.writeUInt8(256, 0)); t(() => buf.writeInt8(-129, 0)); t(() => buf.writeUInt16LE(70000, 0)); t(() => buf.readUIntBE(0, 7)); t(() => buf.writeBigInt64BE(1n, 1)); }
